MBA Monday Leisure Ride

South Bend, IN

No-dropBeginner friendly

MBA Monday Leisure Ride is a road and social group ride in South Bend, IN. It meets every Monday, 6:00 pm, April–September and beyond if weather allows, starting at Pinhook Park. Expect about 10–17 miles, 10–13 mph, group stays together.

About the MBA Monday Leisure Ride group ride

A hosted leisure ride from Pinhook Park. Ten to seventeen miles at 10–13 mph, and the group always stays together. Distance grows through the season.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
